name: Greedy Pumpking
review:
A Halloween cluster game on a hexagonal grid. Multiplier wilds move across the board and merge to get stronger, and in the bonus they stick around.

Candy corn, jack-o'-lanterns and a gluttonous pumpkin king set a spooky-silly tone, and merging wilds can stack big multipliers. High volatility, 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.15%, below average, and there's no demo on this page.
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
